text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Osaka Hai. Agnes Tachyon seems relaxed as she prepares for the race in front of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She promises me several victories for joining her on this journey beyond limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thus, she heads off for the race with a sinister grin. Here is where her legend begins.
